QUOTE: That switch is generated at build time by `scripts/generate_errors.pl`, so a contributor adds a code by declaring it in a public header and rebuilding... `library/CMakeLists.txt:134` runs `generate_errors.pl` as a custom command. It takes `include/mbedtls` and `scripts/data_files` as inputs... The rule's dependencies are `generate_errors.pl`, the `error_headers` list, and `scripts/data_files/error.fmt`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states error.c is generated from the public headers by generate_errors.pl, with error.fmt listed as a dependency of the rule. It never says outright that error.fmt is the template, and it admits it could not confirm "the format template", so the template role is only implied.
